name: wireflow
description: Clickable wireflow review: a journey board with primary path, exceptions, decisions, metrics, and log events, connected mock screens, scenario checks, and copyable change requests.

interface.shortDescription: Review a user journey as an auto-laid-out board or clickable mock screens.
interface.longDescription: Wireflow turns a brief, screenshots, routes, or a feature-intake analysis into an editable flow JSON and a single self-contained HTML viewer. Before screens exist, the journey board lays the flow out by stage: the primary path runs along a spine, drop-out exceptions and open decisions sit in bands below, cards carry chips for state, metrics, experiments, notifications, and exception codes, and a log-list tab lists the events to track. The same file opens as connected mock screens per device. Scenarios replay main journeys and recovery paths (cancel, back, retry) and flag dead ends and missing links. Fix proposals can be previewed without touching the baseline, and reviewers copy precise per-screen change requests back to the agent.
